details: Implementation Plan I have what I need. Both changes fit into existing helpers: the report-side cleanup reuses the follow-up listing inside `single_pass_open_followups`, and the merge-side guard becomes a new mode of the security-pass script, called from `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh`. Writing the plan now. ## Implementation plan: retire superseded single-issue security-pass follow-ups after a clean audit **Planning ref:** `main` @ `a139ffb07e10359f509bf6429948ab6b9d2a9dfe`. The `Integration branch mismatch:` line reads `unknown` (not `true`), so this plan proceeds. The `isolated-base` branch is present; every behaviour cited below was read from this checkout. **Automation / scheduling surface (§20.E)** - Only existing scripts change: `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh`, which gets a new function and a new mode inside the existing script, and `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh`. No new script, supervisor or DB work, and no `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry. - Entry points are unchanged: - `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml`, step "...report" (line 488, `review_single_issue_security_pass.sh report`), runs after each audit that was dispatched with `pr_number`. - `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, step "Enable auto-merge on PR" (line 4399), runs `review_enable_auto_merge.sh` on every clean review, through `internal-review.yml` / `ai-review.yml`. - No workflow YAML edit is needed. Both helpers are already in `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` (`scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:57`). ## Files likely to change - `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh` - `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` - `tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py` - `changelog.d/9479-security-pass-retire-superseded-followups.md` (new) - `agents.d/9479-security-pass-retire-superseded-followups.md` (new) ## Acceptance ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py::test_clean_report_retires_superseded_followups red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py::test_clean_report_leaves_unrelated_issues_open red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py::test_followup_merge_guard_refuses_into_clean_audited_head red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py::test_followup_merge_guard_allows_when_latest_marker_is_findings red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: both helpers run only inside security-audit and review runs started by PR or audit events; no post-merge workflow exercises them ## Functions or modules to implement ### 1. `scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh` (follows the existing `single_pass_*` style: tabs, opening brace on its own line) **a) Extract the listing out of `single_pass_open_followups` (lines 270-308) into `single_pass_followup_issues `.** - Make the same single paginated call, `gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/${REPOSITORY}/issues?labels=ai:security&state=open&per_page=100"`, with the same `gh_retry` fallback and the same shape check. Keep the URL string byte-for-byte: the gate tests assert the exact call list. - Keep the same jq filter: not a pull request, `.user.login == $author`, `.state == "open"`, a string body, and an `Integration branch:` / `**Integration branch:**` line equal to `$ref` after stripping whitespace, `- ` and backticks. - Output a JSON array of `{number, marker}`. `marker` is the issue body's first line, kept only when it matches `^$`. Drop entries whose `.number` is not a positive integer. - Return 1 on any listing or parse failure, as today. - `single_pass_open_followups ` keeps its signature, its output (an integer count) and its failure behaviour. It calls the new helper and counts the IDs whose `` appears among the markers. Gate behaviour does not change. **b) Add `single_pass_retire_followups `, which always returns 0.** 1. `issues_json = single_pass_followup_issues "${head_ref}"`, keeping only entries that have a non-empty `marker`. This meets the requirement that the issue carries ``. - On listing failure, log `single_pass_log "mode=report pr=${pr_number} head=${head_sha} outcome=followup_retire_failed reason=listing_failed"`, emit `::warning::`, and return 0. - When no issues match, return 0 with no further calls. 2. List the PRs targeting the head ref with one paginated call: `gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&base=&per_page=100"`. This uses `gh_retry` when available and makes no per-issue read. - Comment above the call (§14): the issues listing has no PR state or base, and the report's `pulls/` read covers only the audited PR. - Match a PR to follow-up issue `N` when `.head.repo.full_name == REPOSITORY`, `.base.ref == head_ref`, `.state == "open"` and `.head.ref` matches `^ai/issue-N([-/].*)?$`. That is the implement branch convention, the same regex as `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5692`. - If this listing fails, log `outcome=followup_retire_failed reason=pr_listing_failed`. Still close the issues (see D3). 3. For each matched PR: - post `gh api repos/R/issues//comments -f body=...`. The comment says that the single-issue security audit of `` on PR # came back clean, so this follow-up is superseded and closed. It ends with the marker line ``; - then close it with `gh api -X PATCH repos/R/pulls/ -f state=closed`. - A failure logs `outcome=followup_retire_failed reason=pr_close_failed item=` (or `reason=comment_failed item=`) and moves on to the next item. 4. For each issue: - post a comment saying the clean audit of `` (PR #) superseded it, with the same marker line; - then close it with `gh api -X PATCH repos/R/issues/ -f state=closed -f state_reason=not_planned`. - A failure logs `reason=issue_close_failed item=` (or `comment_failed`) and moves on. 5. Finish with `single_pass_log "mode=report pr=... head=... outcome=followups_retired issues= prs="`. - Every call runs under the script's existing `set -uo pipefail` (no `-e`). Every failure path ends in a log line and never calls `exit`. **c) Wire it into `single_pass_report` (lines 578-686).** - When `status == "clean"` and the comment POST succeeded (after line 677), call `single_pass_retire_followups "${pr_number}" "${SECURITY_PASS_AUDIT_BRANCH}" "${head_sha}"`. - Place the call before the review re-dispatch block, which keeps that block's condition unchanged. This shrinks the window in which a follow-up PR can merge into the clean head. - `SECURITY_PASS_AUDIT_BRANCH` is already bound to the live PR's `.head.ref` by the jq check at lines 609-612. - The final `outcome=clean` log line remains the last line, and the marker body is unchanged. **d) Add `single_pass_followup_merge_guard` and a new subcommand, `followup-guard`.** - Inputs: `REPOSITORY`, `PR_NUMBER`, `PR_PAYLOAD_FILE` (the follow-up PR's `/pulls/` JSON), optional `PR_ISSUE_COMMENTS_FILE`, optional `DEFAULT_BRANCH`, and `ORCH_INTEGRATION_BRANCH_PATTERN` (default `^orchestrator/project-`). - Source `gh_helpers.sh` from the script's own directory when it exists. - It prints exactly one line, `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_FOLLOWUP_MERGE=allow|refuse|unverifiable`, plus one `single_pass_log "mode=followup_guard pr= parent= head= outcome= reason="` line. - Steps: 1. Read `base_ref` from `.base.ref`. Read the default branch from `${DEFAULT_BRANCH:-}`, falling back to `.base.repo.default_branch`. - Allow with no API call when `base_ref` is empty, `base_ref` equals the default branch (`reason=default_base`), or `base_ref` matches the integration pattern (`reason=integration_base`). - Allow with `reason=default_branch_unknown` when the default branch is unknown (D4). 2. Find the parent PR with one call: `gh api "repos/R/pulls?state=open&head=:<@uri base_ref>&per_page=100"`. - Select entries where `.head.repo.full_name == REPOSITORY`, `.head.ref == base_ref` and `.base.ref == default_branch`. - None found: allow, `reason=no_standalone_parent`. Call failure or malformed JSON: `unverifiable`, `reason=parent_lookup_failed`. 3. Get the identity: `SECURITY_PASS_AUTHOR_LOGIN = gh api user --jq '.login // ""'`, falling back to `SECURITY_PASS_AUTHOR_LOGIN_FALLBACK`. Empty: `unverifiable`, `reason=author_unverifiable`. 4. Read the parent's comments with one paginated call, `repos/R/issues//comments?per_page=100`, slurped into a temp file the same way `single_pass_report` does it. - Run `single_pass_markers` on that file (no second parser). - Pick the last row with `$4 == parent_head_sha && $3 != "pending"`. - Parse failure: `unverifiable`, `reason=markers_unverifiable`. 5. If that status is `clean`, refuse with `reason=parent_head_clean`, after commenting once: - The comment's last line is ``. - Skip the POST when a pipeline-authored comment already ends with that exact line. Check `PR_ISSUE_COMMENTS_FILE` when it holds a readable JSON array; otherwise do one paginated read of the follow-up PR's comments. - A failed comment POST still refuses, and logs `reason=parent_head_clean comment=failed`. 6. Otherwise allow with `reason=parent_head_`. - Add a `followup-guard)` arm to the `case` at the bottom of the script. The usage string becomes `gate|status|report|followup-guard`. - Update the header comment with the mode description and its API budget, and add the report-mode budget for a clean result. ### 2. `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` - Insert the guard after the head-b
